question: With which of the following musical instruments was the musician Bismillah Khan associated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shehnai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ustad Bismillah Khan was associated with the Shehnai which is a subcontinental wind instrument in India**__.

 __
 
• This instrument is played in special ceremonies such as receptions, marriages and festivals.
 
• At the age of six, he moved to Varanasi in the state of Uttar Pradesh to teach his maternal uncle Ali Baks Vilayatu Khan, a shehnai player associated with the Kashi Vishwanath temple.
 
• At the age of 14, Bismillah accompanied his uncle to the Allahabad Sangeet Sammelan.
 
• In 1932, at the age of 16, he entered into an arranged marriage with a cousin.
 
• He died of cardiac arrest on 21 August 2006.
